**Goal.** Add a nonlinear covariate effect to the stage-2 truth and fit a GAM. Smooths are basis functions with a penalty, which sets up the Hefley spatial basis in stage 4. (Optional detour: the spatial thread goes straight from stage 2 to stage 4.)

```{r}
#| label: setup
source("../sim/_load.R")
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(mgcv)
HTrees2 <- read.table(file.path(data_dir, "abundance.only.natural.trees.txt"),
                      header = TRUE, dec = ".")
```
